name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Placeholder shapes in the layout of content that is still loading.

when: A layout is loading and its shape is known.

instead.when: The layout of what loads is unknown or very small.
The task's progress can be measured.

builtIn: SkeletonGroup marks the region busy and announces when it has loaded.
youProvide: A `label` on SkeletonGroup that says what is loading.
